keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «다들 골을 넣고 싶어서 아무도 패스하지 않았다(문제)» 와 «패스하고 서로 말하는 것을 연습했다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (everyone wanted to score, so nobody passed) and the solution (they practiced passing and talking to each other). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why did Mina's team lose the first game?
qs.qko: 미나의 팀은 왜 첫 경기에서 졌나요?
evs: Mina's soccer team had a big game on Saturday.
The players sat on the grass and felt sad and angry.
Every player wanted to score, so nobody passed the ball.
In their next game, they passed well and won two to one.
why: 모두 골을 넣고 싶어서 아무도 패스하지 않았다고 본문에 나와요. 비가 왔다거나 선수가 적었다는 말은 없어요.
The text says everyone wanted to score, so nobody passed. Nothing says it rained or that they had few players.

qs.q: Coach Park said, "You played as eleven people, not as one team." What does he mean?
qs.qko: 박 코치님이 "You played as eleven people, not as one team."이라고 했어요. 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: Each player played alone, without helping the others.
There were too many players on the field.
The team needed eleven new players.
evs: At the end, the other team won by three goals.
Every player wanted to score, so nobody passed the ball.
Mina's soccer team had a big game on Saturday.
In their next game, they passed well and won two to one.
why: 모두 자기가 골을 넣으려고 패스를 안 했어요. 그래서 한 팀이 아니라 열한 명이 따로따로 뛰었다는 뜻이에요.
Everyone tried to score alone and nobody passed. So they played as eleven separate people, not as one team.

qs.q: Why did the team win the next game?
opts: They practiced passing and then passed well.
The other team had a sick player.
Mina scored all the goals by herself.
evs: The next week, they practiced passing and talking to each other on the field.
The players sat on the grass and felt sad and angry.
In their next game, they passed well and won two to one.
They ran into each other and lost the ball again and again.
why: 선수들은 패스를 연습했고, 다음 경기에서 패스를 잘해서 이겼어요. 두 문장을 이으면 이긴 이유가 보여요.
They practiced passing, and in the next game they passed well and won. Put these two clues together.

ends: Mina's team plays in a big final game.
A new player joins the team and wants to be the star.
새로 온 선수가 혼자 스타가 되고 싶어 해요.

write.src: “Let’s <u>pass the ball</u> so that <u>everyone can play</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그 목적» 으로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write something to do together and its purpose in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을 할 수 있다» 를 쓰세요. (예: so that we can win)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who + what they can do. (e.g. so that we can win)
